mapper.select: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT r.* FROM studyroom_runs r JOIN study_rooms s ON s.id=r.room_id WHERE r.id=#{runId} AND r.user_id=#{userId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id FROM study_rooms WHERE id=#{roomId} AND current_run_id=#{runId}
SELECT * FROM study_rooms WHERE id=#{roomId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM studyroom_fragments WHERE id=#{fragmentId} AND run_id=#{runId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM studyroom_generation_jobs WHERE id=#{jobId} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND lease_until>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
SELECT unit_order FROM studyroom_units WHERE id=#{unitId}
mapper.update: UPDATE studyroom_fragment_versions SET status='READY',content_json=#{contentJson},resource_revision=#{resourceRevision},issues_json=NULL WHERE fragment_id=#{fragmentId} AND revision=#{revision}
UPDATE studyroom_runs SET status='ACTIVE' WHERE id=#{runId}
UPDATE studyroom_runs SET state_version=state_version+1 WHERE id=#{runId}
UPDATE studyroom_generation_jobs SET status='SUCCEEDED',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{jobId} AND lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND status='RUNNING'
